title: Group and/or mark tasks according to screen
line: The Task Manager has a new "By screen" sort option that keeps the tasks of each screen together, from the leftmost screen to the right.
explanation: The Task Manager could only filter tasks to the current screen; there was no way to see tasks of all screens with those of each screen kept together, so on a multi-monitor setup with one panel the tasks of different screens were mixed. libtaskmanager gets a new SortScreen mode: tasks are ordered by the position of their window's screen (left to right, then top to bottom, mirrored for right-to-left layouts), then alphabetically within a screen. A group is placed by the first screen any of its windows is on, and the model re-sorts live when a window moves to another screen. The Task Manager settings offer it as "By screen" in the Sort list.

commits.message:
libtaskmanager: add a sort mode that sorts tasks by screen

With several screens there was no way to keep the tasks of each screen
together in a task manager. The new SortScreen mode orders tasks by the
position of their screen, then alphabetically within the same screen.

BUG: 480637

applets/taskmanager: offer sorting tasks by screen

With several screens, tasks of windows on different screens were mixed
in the task manager. Add a "By screen" sort option, which keeps tasks of
the same screen together, ordered from the leftmost screen to the right.

BUG: 480637

patches.diff:
From 27d09af25505a70f2989672648976de188c5012d Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 21:09:38 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applets/taskmanager: offer sorting tasks by screen

With several screens, tasks of windows on different screens were mixed
in the task manager. Add a "By screen" sort option, which keeps tasks of
the same screen together, ordered from the leftmost screen to the right.

BUG: 480637
---
 applets/taskmanager/qml/ConfigBehavior.qml | 4 ++++
 applets/taskmanager/qml/main.qml           | 2 ++
 2 files changed, 6 insertions(+)

diff --git a/applets/taskmanager/qml/ConfigBehavior.qml b/applets/taskmanager/qml/ConfigBehavior.qml
index bd4b7cf008..b0e36f78f2 100644
--- a/applets/taskmanager/qml/ConfigBehavior.qml
+++ b/applets/taskmanager/qml/ConfigBehavior.qml
@@ -154,6 +154,10 @@ KCMUtils.SimpleKCM {
                     "text": i18nc("@item:inlistbox sort tasks in grouped task", "By horizontal window position"),
                     "value": TaskManager.TasksModel.SortWindowPositionHorizontal,
                 },
+                {
+                    "text": i18nc("@item:inlistbox sort tasks in grouped task", "By screen"),
+                    "value": TaskManager.TasksModel.SortScreen,
+                },
             ]
             onActivated: root.cfg_sortingStrategy = currentValue
             Component.onCompleted: currentIndex = indexOfValue(root.cfg_sortingStrategy)
diff --git a/applets/taskmanager/qml/main.qml b/applets/taskmanager/qml/main.qml
index d0a62d21bc..ef578c1cb1 100644
--- a/applets/taskmanager/qml/main.qml
+++ b/applets/taskmanager/qml/main.qml
@@ -213,6 +213,8 @@ PlasmoidItem {
             // 5 is SortLastActivated, skipped
             case 6:
                 return TaskManager.TasksModel.SortWindowPositionHorizontal;
+            case 7:
+                return TaskManager.TasksModel.SortScreen;
             default:
                 return TaskManager.TasksModel.SortDisabled;
             }
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Two screens, panel on the left one; Konsole and Menu Editor on the left screen, Dolphin, System Settings and Info Center on the right: the tasks are mixed (Dolphin, Konsole, System Settings, Info Center, Menu Editor)
Same windows with Sort: By screen: the left screen's Konsole and Menu Editor come first, then the right screen's Dolphin, Info Center and System Settings
Task Manager settings, Sort list on master: no screen option
Sort list with the fix: new "By screen" entry at the end
Menu Editor moved to the right screen (Meta+Shift+Right): its task moves right away into the right screen's tasks
